title: Bar Salts Blue Sour Raspberry 10ml Longfill E-Liquid By Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape’s Bar Salts Blue Sour Raspberry longfill infuses the sharp, tart essence of blue raspberries with an irresistible sour kick, creating a vibrant vaping experience for any vaper who love a flavour profile with a wickedly sweet and sour edge. This flavour concentrate is perfect for DIY vapers looking to craft an e-liquid that delivers a bold taste with a satisfyingly sour edge. This longfill is part of Vampire Vape's comprehensive Bar Salts series, offering a selection of ten flavour concentrates that allow for deep customisation of your vaping experience. Simply add nicotine shots to achieve your desired nicotine level and a VG/PG base to customise the thickness and vapour production to your liking. What are Longfills? Vampire Vape Bar Salts Longfill e-liquids come with 10ml of flavour concentrate in a 60ml bottle, letting you add your preferred amount of nicotine shots (optional) and PG/VG base e-liquid . This means you have full control over the strength and ratio of your e-liquid. Unlike shortfills, which only go up to 3mg (with 1 x nic shot in a 50ml shortfill bottle), Longfills can be mixed to 0mg, 1.5mg, 3mg, and 6mg strengths depending on how many nicotine shots you add. How to Mix Your Longfill: Understand Your Longfill: Each bottle contains 10ml of flavour concentrate in a 60ml bottle. Choose the Right Nicotine Shot: For 1.5mg Strength: Add half a 10ml 18mg nicotine shot. For 3mg Strength: Add one 10ml 18mg nicotine shot. For 6mg Strength: Add two 10ml 18mg nicotine shots (add less PG/VG Base Mix to make space). Add Base Mix: Top up the bottle with a PG/VG base mix to create 60ml of e-liquid. Shake Well: Shake the bottle vigorously for a few minutes to ensure even distribution. Let it Steep (Optional): Allow the mixed liquid to steep for a few hours or overnight to enhance flavour. Recommended Kits: Depending upon the type of VG/PG Base E-liquid you choose, you can create an e-liquid that perfectly suits your device and vaping style. Use a 70/30 base mix to create a High-VG e-liquid that’s ideal for advanced vape kits and sub-ohm coils , and DTL (direct-to-lung) vaping. Use a 50/50 Base mix to create a balanced e-liquid suitable for Pod Kits , Starter Kits and high-resistance coils, and MTL (mouth-to-lung) or RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping. Troubleshooting: Burnt Taste? Ensure you are using the correct kit and that the e-liquid is mixed properly.
